title: Querying
description: Learn LINQ queries, eager loading, raw SQL, and bulk operations.
longDescription: This module covers LINQ-to-Entities queries, eager loading with Include/ThenInclude, raw SQL queries, and bulk operations with ExecuteDelete/ExecuteUpdate.
whatYouLearn: Write LINQ-to-Entities queries with C# functions
Use Include and ThenInclude for eager loading
Execute raw SQL queries with FromSql
